properties.description: Four tests through the served tools. The same decision is debt while proposed and not while deferred — measured on ONE node before and after in loop_status' assigned decisions and what_next's open pool, so the test cannot pass by the lists being empty for another reason. Neither gap detector raises a deferred decision. Deferring wants the owner's name: refused at the constructor, reported at the setter. A deferred choice cannot have alternatives registered. Mutating the two readers to count deferred as owed makes exactly the first test fail, on the assertion that names the point.
properties.name: a_set_aside_decision_is_not_debt.rs
